summary: Iteration 8 (multi-page PDF upload + CSV/XLSX export + shareable client links) FULLY PASSED end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_pdf_share_export.py — 9 pytest tests in 3 suites, all passing in 17.20s (TestPdfUpload: 4 tests, TestExports: 2 tests, TestShare: 3 tests). Generated a 2-page synthetic PDF with reportlab (Plan + Elevation pages), uploaded via POST /api/projects/{id}/documents/upload, asserted pages_total=2, pages_done=2, is_pdf=true, status=done end-to-end (~25s including 2 GPT-4o vision calls). Verified single-image upload regression (is_pdf=false, pages_total=1), 17MB size rejection (400), text/plain rejection (400). CSV export: Content-Type text/csv, UTF-8 BOM (0xEF 0xBB 0xBF) at byte 0, exact header row, AUTO/AI/blank Source labels, last non-empty row = GRAND TOTAL, utilities BOM present (Septic/EMT/Water main). XLSX export: correct openpyxl mimetype, header at row found with 'Material' at column C (index 3), GRAND TOTAL row last, currency columns formatted with $ number_format. Share: enable returns urlsafe token, GET idempotent, public GET /api/share/{token} works with NO auth header, exposes project/owner/blueprint/materials/grand_total, scrubs password_hash + entitlements from owner, public CSV with BOM works no-auth, rotate generates new token and invalidates old (404 on old), disable removes token (404), cross-user isolation verified (User B 404 on User A's share). Frontend: live UI on the admin's TEST_iter7_ui_dedup project — SHARE button in header opens modal showing token URL with /share/<token>, all 4 action buttons (Copy, Open, Rotate, Revoke/disable) rendered with correct testids. Materials tab shows 3 export buttons (download-csv-button, download-xlsx-button, download-pdf-button), all enabled with 4 material rows; clicking CSV triggers HTTP 200 download with Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="atlas_takeoff_*.csv". Documents tab file input accept attr = 'image/png,image/jpeg,image/jpg,image/webp,application/pdf,.pdf' and helper text shows MAX 16MB. SharedProject page at /share/<token> with cleared localStorage/cookies renders shared-project-name, shared-grand-total ($23,723.01), all 3 tabs (3D/Plan/Mats), shared-download-csv triggers 200 + attachment response, 3D tab has shared-3d-canvas + shared-3d-play + shared-3d-slider with phase animation, Plan tab renders, Materials tab renders 6 shared-cat-* category sections. Owner identity 'PREPARED BY ATLAS ADMIN' visible. Bogus /share/<bad> token shows '// LINK UNAVAILABLE — Share link not found or revoked.' clean error page.

issues: Error wording is 'Share link not found or revoked' (passthrough of backend HTTPException detail) rather than the spec wording 'This link is invalid or has been revoked.' — semantically equivalent and clear, but worth aligning if exact copy matters.

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: documents.py _rasterize_pdf_pages uses pypdfium2 with PDF_RASTER_SCALE=2.0 (~144dpi) and caps at MAX_PDF_PAGES=20 — prevents runaway AI cost on huge PDFs. pdf.close() in finally block prevents resource leak.

GOOD: pipeline run() emits incremental pages_done updates per page (current_page=page_idx+1) so the frontend progress bar is real-time, and accumulates page_summaries[] + walls/doors/windows across all pages before the final blueprint merge — single atomic blueprint update at end avoids partial-state races.

GOOD: Cross-page dedup leverages the same existing_keys/_norm_key fuzzy fallback as iter7 — each page's prompt is built from working_existing which is mutated in-place as new pages add/merge items, so page N's prompt actually sees page N-1's contributions.
GOOD: takeoff.csv writes utf-8-sig (BOM) so Excel auto-detects UTF-8 — handles names like 'Façade'/'¾" PEX' correctly. Source column distinguishes AUTO vs AI vs blank (manual) cleanly.
GOOD: takeoff.xlsx number_format uses '"$"#,##0.00' on unit_price + line_total + grand total cells; column widths and freeze_panes at A5 give a polished Excel deliverable.

GOOD: share.py — public _resolve_shared_project queries only by share_token (correctly indexed conceptually); returned materials_public dict whitelists fields and never leaks document refs, source pages, or internal IDs. owner projection {name:1,email:1,entitlements:1} INCLUDES entitlements which is then dropped in the response dict — good, but slightly safer to drop entitlements from the projection itself.
MINOR: share.py owner projection fetches entitlements but the response only includes name + email — verified no leak; consider removing entitlements from the projection for cleaner intent.

MINOR: bogus token error message ('Share link not found or revoked') is passed through from HTTPException detail; consider standardising on the user-facing copy from the spec ('This link is invalid or has been revoked.') in SharedProject.jsx fallback rendering for consistency.

MINOR: share token is 18-byte urlsafe (~24 chars) — sufficient entropy (~144 bits) but no rate limiting on the public GET /api/share/{token} endpoint; brute-forcing is infeasible but a Mongo index on share_token would help at scale and prevent timing-side-channel inference.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users (test_a_*, test_b_*) and TEST_iter8_* projects via existing conftest.py fixtures. Synthetic 2-page PDF generated in-test via reportlab. Existing admin TEST_iter7_ui_dedup project (with 4 materials + 2 floor-plan docs) used for live UI screenshot verification of share modal + materials export buttons.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 features (multi-page PDF, CSV/XLSX export, shareable links) are fully working backend + frontend. Backend regression suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_pdf_share_export.py runs in ~17s. Test PDF is generated in-test with reportlab (Plan + Elevation rectangles), each ~50KB. Two GPT-4o vision calls fire per PDF run (~10-15s each) so allow ~240s timeout for the full 2-page pipeline test. Share token URL pattern: {BASE}/share/{18-byte-urlsafe-token}. Public endpoints DO NOT require Authorization header — explicit requests.get(url) (no auth) was used in tests and works. Pre-existing failing tests in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_user_settings.py (stale admin password) and TestDocumentPipeline.final_doc (missing fixture) are documented pre-existing failures per the review request and were ignored.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found this iteration. All assertions across 9 backend tests + 6 frontend flows pass on first attempt.
